newsItems.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI

newsItems.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT

newsItems.summary: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.
